verdicts.reason: A keeps the white label panel, headline order and illustrations, so it reads as the same design. Flaws: two stray divider lines float outside the panel at the right, a small dash sits on the left bottle, soap-like fragments are cropped at the bottom, and the panel crowds the top. B is broken: the white panel is empty and displaced to the right, text sits unframed on the beige, the order is wrong (J'adore Paris below the headline), illustrations are shrunk to a tiny strip, and divider lines are orphaned.
